policy.schedules: Visits are evenly spaced during each day. Once-a-day 4/8/16h cases use one contiguous session. Active duration includes waiting inside visits; first visit 60 minutes unless explicitly overridden.
policy.completion: Separate milestones: claimed home5; all production buildings/landmarks at the actual catalog maximum (warehouse excluded); all buildings including warehouse 10; every active recipe produced and claimed; every resident at maximum rank. Observation cases stop at a declared 30-day horizon without claiming completion.
policy.rewards: Actual one-time welcome, eligible tutorial, seven home-tier gifts on canonical cooldown, earned economy achievements. No external social/tap/market achievements.
policy.slots: Buy all second slots before third slots; workshop, woodlot, garden, kiln, dryer priority. Each purchase uses actual domain command and pearl debit.
policy.externalSlots: Alternative stress case adds 3500 stored = 1750 visible pearls explicitly from outside. This is not free progression or an enabled payment claim.
policy.production: Manually start one item per slot; prepare at most owned-slot capacity of current visible requirements. No automatic restart or future-order knowledge.
policy.income: Current visible ordinary orders, spare mining, basic fishing and actual NPCsales. Useful material expeditions use public guaranteed outputs; private finds are not inspected. Leaftail dated supplies may be bought with coins above the next known building or gear budget. No invented market buyers or tap income.
policy.social: Balanced and reputation modes execute actual funded requests and weekly contracts; stock is produced by the same account, never injected. Other modes record naturally earned reputation from income requests and eligible purchases.
policy.speedups: Only explicitly named stresscases spend remaining legitimately earned pearls on construction speedups after prioritized slot purchases. External 3500 raw pearls pays the full slot budget; future slot costs remain reserved and real payments remain disabled.
policy.food: Use owned optional meals after reserving visible order/build/recipe needs. Does not optimize a dedicated cooking strategy.
policy.limits: Deterministic strategy, not population forecast. Two seconds per command is an explicit attention assumption tested at one and four seconds. Earliest source definitions are chosen locally; this is not an optimal speedrun.
